hebrewText: וּ/בְנָיָ֥הוּ וְ/יַחֲזִיאֵ֖ל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים בַּ/חֲצֹצְר֣וֹת תָּמִ֔יד לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים

tokens.bdb: Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites
Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites
literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note)
properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
